title: timeline_set_tween: rotate/rotateCount props not applied
description: When calling timeline_set_tween with props={rotate:'cw', rotateCount:1}, the motionRotate field stays 'none' and motionRotateCount stays 0. Only 'ease' and 'scale' keys appear to be mapped. Expected: 'rotate' maps to motionRotate, 'rotateCount' maps to motionRotateCount. Reproduced in QA demo build (doc-84-mq7s6rll, Shapes layer frame 0).
